subject: LRT testing with categorical data: polychoric correlations and ULSMV

messages.author: 6fd8815462ae9c63
messages.subject: LRT testing with categorical data: polychoric correlations and ULSMV
parts:
Hello folks,

Does anyone know if I can use the anova() or lavTestLRT() functions to compare two (nested) models which were estimated using polychoric corrs and ULSMV? Are there any specific argument I must specify? I know the lavTestLRT function detects the estimation method, but does this apply to poly and ULSMV?

Thank you very much!

Udi

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: LRT testing with categorical data: polychoric correlations and ULSMV
parts:
Yes, lavTestLRT(), which is the function underlying the anova() method for lavaan objects (see class?lavaan), chooses the correct method for the estimator= and test= options specified in the lavaan models you pass to it.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
